input: Read /data/poem.txt and find the 3 most frequently used words. Print each word with its count, one per line, sorted by frequency descending.

tool_calls: tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' < /data/poem.txt | tr -cs '[:alnum:]' '\n' | sort | uniq -c | sort -k1,1nr -k2 | head -3 | awk '{print $2" "$1}'

tool_outputs.stdout:
the cat sat on the mat
the cat in the hat
the dog on the log
the frog on the bog
